name: za-assessed-loss-ring-fencing
description: South African section 20A ring-fencing of assessed losses for natural persons, and the section 20 carry-forward rules it sits on, for the 2027 year of assessment (1 March 2026 to 28 February 2027) and earlier years. Covers the income threshold that triggers ring-fencing and its move by the Taxation Laws Amendment Act 5 of 2026 from the 45% maximum marginal rate to the 39% marginal rate for years of assessment commencing on or after 1 March 2026, the listed suspect trades (including the 2026 wording for farming and animal breeding), the three-out-of-five-years test, the section 20A(3) escape and the residential letting exception, and the company 80% limitation under section 20. Use for questions about ring-fenced losses, suspect trades, hobby farming, rental losses, side businesses, or setting a trade loss off against salary.
